## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. ## How to run it

### Other ways to run it

1. Run it as published (BF16, needs ~797.11 GB, from [huggingface.co/ai21labs](https://huggingface.co/ai21labs/AI21-Jamba-Large-1.6/tree/f75d35d1cd26af70ad1ecc813009cd45ae8f8e13))
   
   ```sh
   uv run --with torch --with 'transformers<5' --with accelerate python -c "from transformers import pipeline; print(pipeline('text-generation', model='ai21labs/AI21-Jamba-Large-1.6', torch_dtype='auto', device_map='auto')('Once upon a time', max_new_tokens=40)[0]['generated_text'])"
   ```

Official weights and documentation: [huggingface.co/ai21labs](https://huggingface.co/ai21labs/AI21-Jamba-Large-1.6)
